in_marathi.name: Taapsee
in_marathi.long_meaning: Taapsee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Taapsee is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tapasya', which means 'penance' or 'to endure'. Taapsee is a name for a girl that is full of strength and beauty. It symbolizes the beauty of a dewdrop that shines in the morning sun, and the strength of a person who endures through difficult times.
